items.item_text: Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, healthcare, or a related field required
5 or more years of experience managing enrollment, claims, or encounters in a Medicare or managed care environment required
5 or more years of experience with CMS processes required
Experience managing vendors to contractual requirements

In this role, you will serve as a liaison between business stakeholders and Application/IT teams, translating business needs into requirements and supporting system solutions for encounter data operations.
Gather and document business and functional requirements, process flows, business cases, system specifications, test cases, and other SDLC materials.
Analyze data, business processes, electronic transactions, and file exchanges to identify system gaps and opportunities to improve processes.
Coordinate testing with trading partners and certification authorities.
Support the design, development, testing, and implementation of software and Tapestry ISS enhancements.
Develop and maintain interface documentation, policies, and procedures.
Investigate operational issues and variances, prepare stakeholder reports, and present findings and recommendations to leadership.
Support internal and external audits, quality control, regulatory requirements, and operational standards.
Note: This posted position is 1 of 2 positions available for hire. All applicants will apply through this requisition and if selected will be hired into one of the available positions.
Computer proficiency with Microsoft Office, SQL, and data visualization tools
Understanding of the healthcare model, capitation, and other managed care IPA and provider reimbursement methodologies
Knowledge of encounter regulatory reporting and compliance requirements
Ability to research and resolve encounter issues
Knowledge of physician/facility billing practices, CPT coding initiatives, ICD-10 coding standards, and revenue and HCPCS coding
Strong leadership, interpersonal, analytical, problem-solving, and prioritizing skills
Excellent oral and written communication skills
Ability to develop, implement, and evaluate methods and systems to improve efficiency
Ability to work well independently as well as part of a team
